title.zh: 上电时序：PWR_OK 之前 CPU 一直在复位里
title.en: Power sequencing: the CPU stays in reset until PWR_OK

description.zh: ATX 电源的三路电压要在 200 毫秒内进到范围，再等 100 到 250 毫秒才拉高 PWR_OK；某一路进不了范围，PWR_OK 就永远不来。
description.en: The ATX rails must reach regulation within 200 ms, then the supply waits 100 to 250 ms before raising PWR_OK; if one rail never reaches its window, PWR_OK never comes.

zh: 按电源键后发生了什么
en: what happens when you press the power button

title.zh: 复位向量：第一条指令在 0xFFFFFFF0
title.en: The reset vector: the first instruction at 0xFFFFFFF0

description.zh: 复位后 CS 的隐藏基址是 FFFF0000H、EIP 是 FFF0H，第一条指令取自 4 GiB 之下 16 字节，主板把固件闪存接在那里。
description.en: After reset the hidden CS base is FFFF0000H and EIP is FFF0H, so the first fetch is 16 bytes below 4 GiB, where the board maps the firmware flash.

title.zh: SPI 闪存：固件放在哪，读一行要多久
title.en: SPI flash: where firmware lives and how long a read takes

description.zh: 按 W25Q256JV 数据手册的命令表算：03h 读 64 字节要 10.88 微秒，四线 EBh 只要 1.11 微秒，开场白占多少决定了快慢。
description.en: From the W25Q256JV command table: a 64-byte read takes 10.88 µs with 03h and 1.11 µs with quad-I/O EBh; the fixed command overhead decides the speed.

title.zh: 硬件信任根：CPU 之前先醒的安全芯片
title.en: Hardware root of trust: the security processor that wakes first

description.zh: AMD 的 PSP 先校验固件、训练内存，再放开 x86 核心；Intel 的 Boot Guard 由微码校验 ACM，ACM 再用熔丝里的公钥哈希校验固件开头。
description.en: AMD's PSP verifies firmware and trains DRAM before releasing the x86 cores; Intel Boot Guard has microcode verify an ACM, which checks the first firmware block against a key hash in fuses.

title.zh: 用缓存当内存，以及开机时间花在哪
title.en: Cache as RAM, and where boot time goes

description.zh: 内存训练之前，固件把缓存锁住当栈用；第一次开机训练占了大半时间，睡眠 S3、休眠 S4、现代待机 S0ix 各跳过不同的段。
description.en: Before DRAM is trained, firmware locks cache lines to use as a stack; on a first boot training dominates, and S3, S4 and S0ix each skip different stages.

title.zh: UEFI 的阶段与 ACPI 表
title.en: UEFI phases and the ACPI tables

description.zh: SEC、PEI、DXE、BDS 一层层把机器搭起来，老式 BIOS 只读第一个扇区到 0x7C00；固件交给操作系统 ACPI 表，MADT 的校验和让所有字节加起来为 0。
description.en: SEC, PEI, DXE and BDS build the machine up in layers, where legacy BIOS just loads sector 0 to 0x7C00; firmware hands over ACPI tables, and a MADT checksum makes every byte sum to 0.

title.zh: GUID 分区表：表头、CRC32 与备份
title.en: The GUID partition table: header, CRC32 and the backup

description.zh: 真的 92 字节 GPT 表头和 CRC32：改一个字节，固件改读硬盘末尾的备份；改完重算 CRC 就发现不了。MBR 最多管 2 TiB。
description.en: A real 92-byte GPT header with CRC32: change one byte and firmware falls back to the backup at the end of the disk; recompute the CRC and nothing notices. MBR tops out at 2 TiB.

title.zh: 安全启动：一级验一级的签名链
title.en: Secure Boot: a chain of signature checks

description.zh: 固件用 db 验 shim，shim 验 GRUB 和内核，先查 dbx；真的 SHA-256 加小号 RSA，换掉一环看它断在哪。
description.en: Firmware checks shim against db, shim checks GRUB and the kernel, dbx first; real SHA-256 and a small RSA show where the chain breaks.

title.zh: 撤销签过名的引导程序：dbx、SBAT 与整张证书
title.en: Revoking signed boot loaders: dbx, SBAT and whole certificates

description.zh: BootHole 往 dbx 加了 150 个哈希；BlackLotus 之后微软拉黑整张 PCA 2011。按哈希、按代数、按证书三种办法的代价对比。
description.en: BootHole put 150 hashes into dbx; after BlackLotus Microsoft revoked the whole PCA 2011 certificate. Compares revoking by hash, by generation and by certificate.

title.zh: 度量启动：TPM 的 PCR 扩展

description.zh: 新值 = SHA-256(旧值 ‖ 度量)，只能往前算；钥匙封存在哪几个 PCR 上，决定升级固件后要不要输恢复密钥。
description.en: New value = SHA-256(old ‖ measurement), forward only; which PCRs a key is sealed to decides whether a firmware update asks for the recovery key.

title.zh: 交给内核，INIT-SIPI-SIPI 叫醒其余核心
title.en: Kernel handoff and waking the other cores with INIT-SIPI-SIPI

description.zh: 引导程序按启动协议交出控制，内核打开自己的分页，再用 INIT 和两次 SIPI 叫醒其余核心；并行叫醒让 112 线程从约 800 毫秒降到约 80 毫秒。
description.en: The loader hands over by the boot protocol, the kernel sets up its own paging, then wakes the other cores with INIT and two SIPIs; parallel bring-up took 112 threads from about 800 ms to about 80 ms.

title.en: How Arm and Apple machines boot

description.zh: Arm 可信固件分 BL1、BL2、BL31、BL33；苹果从启动 ROM 里的根证书公钥开始，经 LLB、iBoot 验到内核。
description.en: Arm Trusted Firmware runs BL1, BL2, BL31 and BL33; Apple starts from the root CA key in the Boot ROM and verifies LLB, iBoot and the kernel in turn.

title.zh: 开机的前沿：证书到期、开源固件与 Pluton
title.en: The frontier: certificate expiry, open firmware and Pluton

description.zh: 微软三张 2011 年安全启动证书在 2026 年到期并换成 2023 版；AMD 的 openSIL、集成进 CPU 的 Pluton。截至 2026 年 11 月。
description.en: Microsoft's three 2011 Secure Boot certificates expired in 2026 and were replaced by 2023 ones; AMD openSIL and the Pluton security processor. As of November 2026.

title.zh: 开不了机时问的三件事
title.en: Three questions when a computer will not boot

description.zh: 卡在固件之前还是之中，安全启动是不认识还是被拉黑，钥匙封在哪几个 PCR 上。
description.en: Is it stuck before or inside firmware, does Secure Boot not know the file or has it been revoked, and which PCRs is the key sealed to.

zh: 升级固件后要恢复密钥

reason.zh: 第 2 章从 CPU 离开复位那一刻讲起，那一刻要等第 1 章的 PWR_OK。
reason.en: Chapter 2 starts at the moment the CPU leaves reset, which waits for chapter 1’s PWR_OK.

label.en: The reset vector points into the flash

reason.zh: 第 3 章读的固件就在第 2 章复位向量对着的那块 SPI 闪存里。
reason.en: The firmware chapter 3 reads sits in the SPI flash that chapter 2’s reset vector points into.

label.en: The flash code is checked first

reason.zh: 第 4 章的 Boot Guard 和 PSP 在 x86 核心醒来之前，先校验第 3 章闪存里的代码。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s Boot Guard and PSP check the code in chapter 3’s flash before the x86 cores wake.

reason.zh: 第 6 章的 SEC 和 PEI 阶段做的就是第 5 章的「用缓存当内存」和内存训练。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s SEC and PEI phases are where chapter 5’s cache-as-RAM and memory training happen.

label.en: BDS looks for a boot entry on the disk

reason.zh: 第 6 章的 BDS 阶段去盘上找 EFI 系统分区，第 7 章讲它在 GPT 里怎么找到。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s BDS phase looks for the EFI system partition, and chapter 7 shows how it is found in the GPT.

label.en: The firmware checks the first link

reason.zh: 第 8 章签名链的第一环，是第 6 章的 UEFI 固件用 db 验 shim。
reason.en: The first link of chapter 8’s chain is chapter 6’s UEFI firmware checking shim against db.

label.en: What was signed must be revocable

reason.zh: 第 9 章讲第 8 章那条签名链里，签过名却有漏洞的引导程序怎么撤销。
reason.en: Chapter 9 shows how a signed but vulnerable boot loader in chapter 8’s chain is revoked.

reason.zh: 第 10 章的度量启动不拦任何代码，只把第 8 章每一环加载的东西记进 PCR。
reason.en: Chapter 10’s measured boot blocks nothing; it records in the PCRs what each link of chapter 8’s chain loaded.

label.zh: MADT 列出要叫醒的核心
label.en: The MADT lists the cores to wake

reason.zh: 第 11 章内核按第 6 章 ACPI 的 MADT 找到其余核心，再用 INIT-SIPI-SIPI 叫醒。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s kernel finds the other cores in chapter 6’s ACPI MADT and wakes them with INIT-SIPI-SIPI.

reason.zh: 第 13 章 2026 年 2011 版证书到期、换成 2023 版，接着第 9 章的撤销往下走。
reason.en: Chapter 13’s 2026 switch from the 2011 certificates to the 2023 ones continues chapter 9’s revocation story.

reason.zh: 第 5 章的开机时间线里，第一次开机最长的一段是内存总线那篇第 7 章讲的训练。
reason.en: In chapter 5’s boot timeline, the longest stage of a first boot is the training covered in the memory-bus essay’s chapter 7.

reason.zh: 第 6 章 DXE 阶段的 PCI 总线驱动做的，就是 PCIe 那篇第 6 章的枚举和 BAR 分配。
reason.en: The PCI bus driver in chapter 6’s DXE phase does the enumeration and BAR assignment of the PCIe essay’s chapter 6.

label.zh: 到今天还在用的小总线

reason.zh: 第 3 章的 SPI 闪存挂在零件连接那篇第 8 章讲的小总线上。
reason.en: Chapter 3’s SPI flash hangs on one of the small buses the wiring essay covers in its chapter 8.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的 GPT 表头和分区项都按硬盘那篇第 1 章的 LBA 编号放。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s GPT header and entries are placed by the LBA numbers of the drive essay’s chapter 1.

label.en: Paging is on at the handoff

reason.zh: 第 11 章的 64 位启动协议要求进内核时已开分页，页表怎么走见虚拟内存那篇第 3 章。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s 64-bit boot protocol enters the kernel with paging on; the virtual-memory essay’s chapter 3 walks those tables.

reason.zh: 第 8 章的签名链用小号 RSA 验签，RSA 本身见 RSA 公钥加密那一课。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s chain verifies small RSA signatures; RSA itself is in the RSA lesson.
